heroes.name: Mara Venn
heroes.signature: Guards allies, then punishes pressure at the front.
heroes.strength: Reliable protection and front-line control.
heroes.weakness: Most defining actions fail from the back ranks.
heroes.summary: Durable frontliner who guards allies and controls enemy ranks.

heroes.name: Ivo Senn
heroes.signature: Turns marks and formation changes into energy and protection.
heroes.strength: Excellent hand, energy, and rank correction.
heroes.weakness: Loses its strongest tools when forced to rank 1.
heroes.summary: Flexible controller who moves combatants and manipulates energy.

heroes.name: Dr. Orra Vale
heroes.signature: Repairs health, stress, wounds, and Death's Door crises.
heroes.strength: Best direct recovery and emergency stabilization.
heroes.weakness: Low damage makes slow fights increasingly dangerous.
heroes.summary: Dedicated recovery specialist for health, stress, and emergencies.

heroes.name: Kei Rook
heroes.signature: Marks any target, cycles the hand, and fires from the back.
heroes.strength: Wide target reach and high marked-target burst.
heroes.weakness: Forward displacement disables its best shots.
heroes.summary: Mobile backliner who marks targets and cycles through the deck.

heroes.name: Dax Rell
heroes.signature: Crashes into point-blank range and scatters the enemy line.
heroes.strength: Immediate front-rank damage and displacement.
heroes.weakness: Recoil and self-stress demand formation support.
heroes.summary: Explosive front-rank attacker with burst damage and forced movement.

heroes.name: Nia Voss
heroes.signature: Reorders and disables enemies while gambling with stress.
heroes.strength: Powerful whole-line control and setup.
heroes.weakness: Fragile, stress-hungry, and weak when pulled forward.
heroes.summary: Fragile control specialist who trades stress for stuns and disruption.

heroes.name: Bram Coil
heroes.signature: Smooths the shared hand and distributes scarce protection.
heroes.strength: Makes expensive and mixed-owner decks more consistent.
heroes.weakness: Adds little burst pressure without allied finishers.
heroes.summary: Card-economy support who distributes protection and extra actions.

heroes.name: Sable Kade
heroes.signature: Creates or cashes marks, then vanishes before retaliation.
heroes.strength: Precise payoff damage against priority targets.
heroes.weakness: Needs setup and safe back ranks for peak output.
heroes.summary: Precise mobile assassin who exploits marks and vulnerable targets.

heroes.name: Dr. Yara Moss
heroes.signature: Cultivates wounds, then converts them into damage or recovery.
heroes.strength: Sustained attrition and adaptable treatment.
heroes.weakness: Slow setup can lose races against immediate pressure.
heroes.summary: Attrition specialist using wounds, weakness, and regenerative support.

heroes.name: Unit Lumen
heroes.signature: Anchors the line while charging flexible hardlight actions.
heroes.strength: Reliable defense, guard, and energy support.
heroes.weakness: Card draw can outpace the party's shared energy.
heroes.summary: Resilient energy support with hardlight defenses and reliable control.

heroes.name: Tal Ren
heroes.signature: Evades a committed attack and answers it with a riposte.
heroes.strength: Efficient single-target counterpressure.
heroes.weakness: Wide attacks and enemy backliners bypass its duel.
heroes.summary: Mobile counterattacker who evades single hits and punishes direct attackers.

heroes.name: Mox Calder
heroes.signature: Turns setup and stress into formation-wide bombardment.
heroes.strength: Exceptional reach and multi-target pressure.
heroes.weakness: Fragile and nearly inert when dragged to the front.
heroes.summary: Fragile backliner who trades stress and setup for heavy bursts and volleys.

heroes.name: Sister Ilex
heroes.signature: Absorbs dread while cleansing and focusing the whole crew.
heroes.strength: Broad morale and status stabilization.
heroes.weakness: Protective turns rely on allies to finish threats.
heroes.summary: Morale support who cleanses ailments, inspires allies, and accepts stress for them.

heroes.name: Pax Null
heroes.signature: Edits enemy states while filtering the shared hand.
heroes.strength: Strong debuffs, setup, and card-flow control.
heroes.weakness: Low durability and poor function from rank 1.
heroes.summary: Disruption specialist who marks, weakens, and jams hostile action loops.

heroes.name: Oren Pike
heroes.signature: Steers specialists into position and hostile ranks out of it.
heroes.strength: Cheap formation correction and displacement.
heroes.weakness: Movement without the right partners wastes tempo.
heroes.summary: Formation support who steers allies and enemies while granting evasive cover.

heroes.name: Eira Glace
heroes.signature: Freezes exposed targets while preserving endangered allies.
heroes.strength: Combines control with resilient rescue tools.
heroes.weakness: Area attacks are costly and immediate damage is modest.
heroes.summary: Cryogenic defender who slows pressure with blocks, weakness, and emergency preservation.

heroes.name: Sol Briar
heroes.signature: Grows wounds into a network of thorns and recovery.
heroes.strength: Sustained protection and attrition support.
heroes.weakness: Needs time or wound setup before it becomes efficient.
heroes.summary: Hydroponic support who grows protection while rooting and wearing down hostiles.

heroes.name: Hark Vela
heroes.signature: Tempers stress into armor and devastating close strikes.
heroes.strength: High durability and front-rank pressure.
heroes.weakness: Heat-driven stress becomes dangerous without relief.
heroes.summary: Foundry bruiser who converts heat and stress into armor and close-range force.

heroes.name: Saint Cira
heroes.signature: Escalates critical energy while containing its stress fallout.
heroes.strength: Flexible energy, marks, wounds, and party defense.
heroes.weakness: Repeated rites can trigger an affliction spiral.
heroes.summary: Volatile reactor mystic balancing party protection against radiation-scarred aggression.

heroes.name: Miko Spore
heroes.signature: Links wounded enemies and allies through restorative spores.
heroes.strength: Efficient attrition support and group cleansing.
heroes.weakness: Limited burst and vulnerable to forward displacement.
heroes.summary: Fungal medic spreading restorative networks and debilitating spores across formations.

heroes.name: Neris Drown
heroes.signature: Uses pressure and lifelines to drag both formations forward.
heroes.strength: Strong line manipulation and stress protection.
heroes.weakness: Cannot pressure enemy back ranks without setup.
heroes.summary: Flooded-zone controller using pressure, ballast, and harpoons to rearrange combat.

heroes.name: Vey Ion
heroes.signature: Chains marked targets into energy and reactive lightning.
heroes.strength: Fast setup, wide reach, and explosive tempo.
heroes.weakness: Fragile and dependent on protected back ranks.
heroes.summary: Storm-channeling striker with chain attacks, reactive guards, and formation disruption.

heroes.name: Ada Quill
heroes.signature: Catalogs targets while revising draws and discards.
heroes.strength: Precise setup and shared-hand filtering.
heroes.weakness: Very poor access to defining cards from the front.
heroes.summary: Archive tactician who marks priority records and restores allies from impossible ledgers.

heroes.name: Oss Null
heroes.signature: Trades stress and position to expose impossible openings.
heroes.strength: Exceptional formation control and emergency evasion.
heroes.weakness: Risk costs compound quickly without stabilization.
heroes.summary: Risk-heavy void adept who bends enemy ranks and exposes targets through absence.

heroes.name: Tern Ivory
heroes.signature: Builds protection from wounds and near-death emergencies.
heroes.strength: Durable guarding and Death's Door stabilization.
heroes.weakness: Short attack reach and modest tempo when nobody is hurt.
heroes.summary: Ossuary guardian who builds durable scaffolds and splints from battlefield remains.

biomes.name: Derelict Decks
biomes.description: Broken machinery, open corridors, and familiar shipboard hazards.

hazard.name: Falling Conduit
hazard.description: A loose conduit strikes the weakest crew member.

traversal.description: Open decking costs one travel tick.

patrol.description: Maintenance packs roam locally, then pursue on sight.

visibility.description: Broken sightlines reveal nearby movement and machinery.

combat.name: Loose Cover
combat.description: Scattered plating gives every combatant 2 block.

objective.name: Signal Relay
objective.description: Splice a corpse-warm relay into the Overseer route.

biomes.name: Cryogenic Vaults
biomes.description: Frozen galleries broken by narrow thaw channels and sealed chambers.

hazard.name: Flash Freeze
hazard.description: Coolant locks every joint and weakens the crew.

traversal.description: Ice makes every tile cost two travel ticks.

patrol.description: Frozen sentries move slowly and remain near their vaults.

visibility.description: Clear ice exposes threats and coolant fractures at range.

combat.name: Brittle Cold
combat.description: Crew and hostiles begin vulnerable for one exchange.

objective.name: Thaw Manifold
objective.description: Recover a routing key from a pressure-frozen manifold.

biomes.name: Hydroponic Canopy
biomes.description: Dense cultivated decks where roots have swallowed the intended paths.

hazard.name: Wirevine Snare
hazard.description: Barbed roots open a wound on one crew member.

traversal.description: Root-choked tiles cost two travel ticks.

patrol.description: Graft sentries circle nutrient sites instead of wandering far.

visibility.description: Foliage hides patrols and snares until they are close.

combat.name: Root Lattice
combat.description: Roots reverse the crew formation as combat begins.

objective.name: Nutrient Oracle
objective.description: Poll a root-memory for one living access phrase.

biomes.name: Ash Foundry
biomes.description: Hot industrial halls, slag islands, and long furnace approaches.

hazard.name: Slag Vent
hazard.description: A furnace cough scorches the entire crew.

traversal.description: Heat and slag cost two travel ticks per tile.

patrol.description: Stokers pursue aggressively through furnace approaches.

visibility.description: Firelight outlines patrols and active vents.

combat.name: Heat Haze
combat.description: Every combatant begins vulnerable in the furnace glare.

objective.name: Tempering Rig
objective.description: Forge an access tooth able to survive the Core lock.

biomes.name: Reactor Choir
biomes.description: Containment cells and branching service arteries vibrating with charge.

hazard.name: Gamma Arc
hazard.description: Ionising light marks the crew for waiting hunters.

traversal.description: Charged service arteries remain quick to cross.

patrol.description: Control packs acquire targets early and chase hard.

visibility.description: Charge masks patrol signatures and arcs until nearby.

combat.name: Charged Air
combat.description: Crew begin marked while hostiles begin focused.

objective.name: Control Cascade
objective.description: Divert a reactor vote into the Overseer's authorization bus.

biomes.name: Mycelial Warrens
biomes.description: Soft colonies and rounded pockets connected by living filaments.

hazard.name: Spore Bloom
hazard.description: A ripe colony wounds a random breathing thing.

traversal.description: Soft mycelial paths cost one travel tick.

patrol.description: Puppeted patrols stagger unpredictably around their nests.

visibility.description: Dense spores conceal motion and blooms almost completely.

combat.name: Shared Spores
combat.description: Crew begin weak; hostiles begin wounded by their own bloom.

objective.name: Apothecary Fruiting
objective.description: Distil a living solvent for the Core's organic seal.

biomes.name: Flooded Bilges
biomes.description: Submerged compartments and thin causeways beneath immense pressure.

hazard.name: Pressure Sump
hazard.description: A false floor swallows one supply; without one, panic follows.

traversal.description: Deep water costs three travel ticks per tile.

patrol.description: Heavy bilge patrols are slow and tightly territorial.

visibility.description: Ripples reveal sumps early but shapes remain indistinct.

combat.name: Undertow
combat.description: The first pressure surge reverses the crew formation.

objective.name: Pressure Locker
objective.description: Raise a drowned credential from a buckled locker.

biomes.name: Ion Stormworks
biomes.description: Wind-scoured conduits where static rolls through fractured open spaces.

hazard.name: Static Front
hazard.description: A moving charge strips light from every working lamp.

traversal.description: Tailwinds make open conduits cost one travel tick.

patrol.description: Static drives patrols quickly and unpredictably across long spans.

visibility.description: Lightning silhouettes distant threats but fronts form quickly.

combat.name: Static Wind
combat.description: Draw one extra card but lose one energy in round one.

objective.name: Grounding Mast
objective.description: Ground a storm pulse carrying an Overseer handshake.

biomes.name: Impossible Archive
biomes.description: Shelf-like lanes, indexed chambers, and records that redraw their aisles.

hazard.name: Redaction Field
hazard.description: A missing paragraph erases one card from the opening hand of the next fight.

traversal.description: Contradictory shelf coordinates cost two travel ticks.

patrol.description: Index patrols guard records and rarely leave their assigned aisle.

visibility.description: The catalogue discloses every indexed patrol and redaction field.

combat.name: Redacted Clause
combat.description: The opening combat hand contains one fewer card.

objective.name: Revision Desk
objective.description: Amend the record so the Core remembers authorising you.

biomes.name: Null Expanse
biomes.description: Sparse islands of structure linked across regions of apparent absence.

hazard.name: Null Gaze
hazard.description: The emptiness notices the most stressed crew member.

traversal.description: Distances slip; each apparent tile costs two travel ticks.

patrol.description: Null hunters wait between movements, then close deliberately.

visibility.description: Both hunters and hazards disappear beyond immediate structure.

combat.name: Null Tide
combat.description: The crew gains one opening energy and six stress each.

objective.name: Grief Lens
objective.description: Focus an absent navigator into a route the Core must accept.

biomes.name: Ossuary Engine
biomes.description: Ribbed vaults and bone-white maintenance crypts built around dead machinery.

hazard.name: Bone Tax
hazard.description: The floor takes blood from the weakest survivor.

traversal.description: Ribbed maintenance crypts cost one travel tick.

patrol.description: Bone processions roam crypt circuits before converging.

visibility.description: White bone shows movement and blood-grooves at medium range.

combat.name: Bone Churn
combat.description: Hostiles begin with 5 block; crew begin ready to riposte.

objective.name: Marrow Pump
objective.description: Prime a dead operator's credential with living blood.

worlds.name: Orison Survey Wreck
worlds.description: A branching survey vessel where industrial decks bleed into impossible records.

worlds.name: Cinder Ark
worlds.description: A long furnace-carrier whose central spine buckles between heat and electrical weather.

worlds.name: Bloom Labyrinth
worlds.description: Interlocked garden laboratories joined by wet roots and archival grafts.

worlds.name: Pelagic Grave
worlds.description: A drowned ring habitat orbiting a central absence through frozen pressure locks.

worlds.name: Ivory Engine
worlds.description: A serpentine engine assembled from bone, records, and living decomposition.

worlds.name: Fracture Field
worlds.description: Separated habitat shards connected by unstable industrial bridges.

afflictions.name: Obsessive

events.name: Sealed Locker
events.text: A crew locker is fused shut. Something taps inside the wall behind it.

events.name: Black Box
events.text: The recorder repeats the final seven seconds of the crew's voices.

events.name: Coolant Leak
events.text: A freezing plume hides the only intact corridor.

events.name: Sleeping Pods
events.text: Four pods remain powered. One display counts backward.

events.name: Quartermaster
events.text: The quartermaster still grips a sealed field case.

events.name: Maintenance Voice
events.text: A cheerful voice requests authorization to vent this deck.

events.name: Fresh Trail
events.text: A bright trail disappears into an unlit service duct.

events.name: Observation Glass
events.text: The stars beyond the glass bend around an impossible absence.

events.name: Unsent Message
events.text: A terminal holds a final message addressed to no one aboard.

events.name: Unstable Cell
events.text: A cracked power cell still carries a dangerous charge.
